name: smwmusic-metroid-heart-of-a-titan-kraid-s-lair-remix
title: Metroid - Heart of a Titan ~ Kraid's Lair (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Kraid's Lair from Metroid. Just started getting into the Metroid series as of recently, but I've been a fan of this song ever since I first heard it in Super Smash Bros Melee in the early 2000s (how I was introduced to the series).

This baby is great for caverns, dark castles / towers, and dark cutscenes.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
